title: Closeout: banner-before-commit with 10s proceed-unless-cancel
description: Current wai-closeout.md autocommits (banner displays after commit). Better UX tested in Minder: show banner BEFORE commit with a 10s countdown — auto-proceeds unless user types no/cancel/stop/abort/wait. Strictly better than autocommit: user sees what will be committed, has a visible escape window, but no friction for the normal case.

perceive.current_state: wai-closeout.md Step 11 says 'Commit and push immediately — no user confirmation required. Banner displays AFTER.' This is fine for explicit invocations but gives no escape window.
evidence: wai-closeout.md line 139: 'no user confirmation required. Banner displays AFTER.'
signal-closeout-banner-invert describes 10s countdown tested in Minder as strictly better
files: tools/closeout.sh (if it handles the banner step)

steps: 2. Update Step 11 to: display banner summary, then read -t 10 with message 'Proceeding in 10s... type cancel to abort'
3. Only abort if user types: no/cancel/stop/abort/wait (case-insensitive)
4. Proceed to commit on timeout or any other input
5. Update Step 12 to note banner was pre-commit
